modules.title: Portable motion foundation
modules.summary: Build a readable visual argument through hierarchy, construction, continuity and reviewed native motion.
whenToUse: Start every motion task here before selecting specialist capabilities or styles.
whenNotToUse: This is guidance, not permission to replace unrelated AE projects.

inputs.name: primary message
inputs.constraints: One clear viewer takeaway; infer sensible defaults and expose them in the brief.

assetRequirements: No private rig or mandatory media.
fontRequirements: Use installed faces; verify approved fallback and remeasure.
fallbacks: Use native shapes and deliberate cuts when assets or continuity mechanisms are unsuitable.
reviewChecks: Read order, text clearance, causal continuity, actual delivered frames and native editability.
Full-speed perceptual playback is distinct from sampled frame and full decode checks.

modules.title: Editable motion typography
modules.summary: Design readable kinetic type, fit full copy, reveal words or lines and replace aligned phrases.
whenToUse: Text-led announcements, editorial titles, expressive emphasis and phrase replacement.
whenNotToUse: Static copywriting or unverified non-Latin/vertical shaping.

inputs.name: copy
inputs.constraints: Exact approved copy and intended reading order.

inputs.name: intensity
inputs.constraints: Adapt to role and audience; helper intensity 0..1.

assetRequirements: Native text; no required external artwork.
fontRequirements: Installed approved faces; verify PostScript name and glyph coverage.
fallbacks: Expand layout when the minimum font size cannot fit.
reviewChecks: Complete readable copy, glyph coverage, layout, reading time, editable layers and conflict preservation.

modules.title: Editable native paper collage
modules.summary: Assemble cut-paper scenes with editable cards, purposeful overlap, shadows and seeded tactile motion.
whenToUse: Paper collage, layered cardstock, cutout scenes and tactile paper movement.
whenNotToUse: Unrelated static writing or a faithful depiction of a real object without suitable artwork.

inputs.name: subject and takeaway
inputs.constraints: State what the collage must communicate and whether a literal object is essential.

inputs.name: material route
inputs.constraints: Supplied cutouts need rights, alpha and resolution checks; generation is optional.

inputs.name: motion intensity
inputs.constraints: Set helper intensity 0..1; zero removes sampled boil.

assetRequirements: Native route needs no supplied media. Literal photographic subjects require suitable cleared artwork.
fontRequirements: Use installed approved faces for native editable labels.
fallbacks: Disclose abstract native paper if literal artwork is absent; do not imply a specific object is depicted.
reviewChecks: Read order, edge/alpha quality, contact/offset shadows, overlap seams, purposeful assembly, full-speed rhythm and native editability.
